body: @kapunahelewong Stackblitz currently does not support uploaded images from stackblitz. I have changed it to use the github rawurl instead.
BTW, there also seems to be an issue with the ZIP archive (potentially related to how we encode the PNG while archiving 🤷‍♂).
Hey! Not sure if this is a regression or bug on our end, but will investigate and circle back by EOD!

Okay, so it appears that the image in that Angular project for some reason didn't successfully upload to our S3 bucket during creation 🤔 Have you noticed any other projects that have exhibited this same behavior? Curious if this is a recurring issue or just a random glitch.

Also, do y'all have a link to that raw image? I can manually upload it to our s3 bucket which should fix this specific project :)

@EricSimons I just checked another example, that doesn't show images either:

https://stackblitz.com/angular/ooydpgymogr?file=src%2Fapp%2Fapp.component.ts

Thx for looking into this, @EricSimons 🤖

##
The image for https://stackblitz.com/angular/envrboojygp is:
- [phone.png][1]

##
The images for https://stackblitz.com/angular/ooydpgymogr are:
- [lamp.png][2]
- [potted-plant.png][3]

##
Any idea if these are random upload issues or we are doing something wrong (i.e. send incorrect data). Can we do anything to help investigate this?

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/aio/content/examples/property-binding/src/assets/phone.png
[2]: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angular/angular/master/aio/content/examples/interpolation/src/assets/lamp.png
[3]: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angular/angular/master/aio/content/examples/interpolation/src/assets/potted-plant.png
@EricSimons Were you able to upload the images? I don't see them in the examples @gkalpak posted above.
